+    def _encode_chunk(self, text_bytes, inf=None):
+        # return the token ids
+        # let's begin. first, convert all bytes to integers in range 0..255
+        # then repeatedly merge the pair with the lowest merge index
+        # (inf: optional int "no merge" rank above every merge index)
+        return apply_merges(list(text_bytes), self.merges, inf)

+    def _no_merge_rank(self):
+        # int sentinel above every merge index: keeps rank compares int-int
+        return max(self.merges.values(), default=0) + 1

+    def _encode_ordinary_into(self, text, ids, cache, inf):
+        # split text into chunks of text by categories defined in regex pattern
+        text_chunks = re.findall(self.compiled_pattern, text)
+        # all chunks of text are encoded separately, then results are joined;
+        # chunks repeat a lot in natural text (" the", ","): encode each
+        # distinct chunk once (cache is shared by the caller)
+        cache_get = cache.get
+        extend = ids.extend
+        encode_chunk = self._encode_chunk
+        for chunk in text_chunks:
+            chunk_ids = cache_get(chunk)
+            if chunk_ids is None:
+                chunk_ids = cache[chunk] = encode_chunk(chunk.encode("utf-8"), inf)
+            extend(chunk_ids)
+
+    def encode_ordinary(self, text):
+        """Encoding that ignores any special tokens."""
+        ids = []
+        self._encode_ordinary_into(text, ids, {}, self._no_merge_rank())
+        return ids

+# below this many pairs, apply_merges' min()/count() passes are cheaper than
+# the bookkeeping of _apply_merges_heap
+_HEAP_MIN_PAIRS = 64
+
+def _apply_merges_heap(ids, ranks, merges_get, inf):
+    """
+    apply_merges() for long sequences, same merges in the same order. Instead
+    of min() and count() passes over the whole rank list at every step, keep
+    the exact number of occurrences of every rank value (counts) and a heap of
+    rank values. Invariant: every value v with counts[v] > 0 has an entry in
+    the heap; entries whose count dropped to 0 are stale and skipped. So the
+    smallest live heap entry is min(ranks), and its count is ranks.count().
+    """
+    counts = {}
+    _count_elements(counts, ranks)
+    counts_get = counts.get
+    heap = list(counts)
+    heapify(heap)
+    while heap:
+        idx = heappop(heap)
+        if idx == inf:
+            break # nothing else can be merged anymore
+        k = counts[idx]
+        if not k:
+            continue # stale entry
+        j = ranks.index(idx)
+        if k == 1:
+            # single occurrence: splice in place, patch the neighbouring ranks
+            ids[j] = idx
+            del ids[j+1]
+            del ranks[j]
+            counts[idx] = 0
+            if j:
+                counts[ranks[j-1]] -= 1
+                r = ranks[j-1] = merges_get((ids[j-1], idx), inf)
+                c = counts_get(r, 0)
+                counts[r] = c + 1
+                if not c:
+                    heappush(heap, r)
+            if j < len(ranks):
+                counts[ranks[j]] -= 1
+                r = ranks[j] = merges_get((idx, ids[j+1]), inf)
+                c = counts_get(r, 0)
+                counts[r] = c + 1
+                if not c:
+                    heappush(heap, r)
+            continue
+        # several occurrences: rebuild as in apply_merges, recording the values
+        # of the old rank positions that are not copied over (gone) and of the
+        # newly computed rank positions (added)
+        p0 = ids[j]
+        p1 = ids[j+1]
+        last = len(ranks) - 1
+        newids = []
+        ext = newids.extend
+        app = newids.append
+        newranks = []
+        rext = newranks.extend
+        rapp = newranks.append
+        gone = []
+        gapp = gone.append
+        added = []
+        aapp = added.append
+        index = ranks.index
+        s = 0
+        first = True
+        while True:
+            k -= 1
+            if ids[j] == p0 and ids[j+1] == p1:
+                if s < j:
+                    if not first:
+                        gapp(ranks[s-1])
+                        r = merges_get((idx, ids[s]), inf)
+                        aapp(r)
+                        rapp(r)
+                    rext(ranks[s:j-1])
+                    gapp(ranks[j-1])
+                    r = merges_get((ids[j-1], idx), inf)
+                    aapp(r)
+                    rapp(r)
+                    ext(ids[s:j])
+                elif not first:
+                    gapp(ranks[j-1])
+                    r = merges_get((idx, idx), inf)
+                    aapp(r)
+                    rapp(r)
+                gapp(idx) # old rank position j
+                app(idx)
+                first = False
+                s = j + 2
+                if j < last and ranks[j+1] == idx:
+                    k -= 1 # overlapping position j+1 is skipped
+                start = s
+            else:
+                start = j + 1
+            if not k:
+                break
+            j = index(idx, start)
+        if s <= last + 1:
+            gapp(ranks[s-1])
+            r = merges_get((idx, ids[s]), inf)
+            aapp(r)
+            rapp(r)
+            rext(ranks[s:])
+            ext(ids[s:])
+        ids = newids
+        ranks = newranks
+        for v in gone:
+            counts[v] -= 1
+        for v in added:
+            c = counts_get(v, 0)
+            counts[v] = c + 1
+            if not c:
+                heappush(heap, v)
+        if counts[idx]:
+            heappush(heap, idx)
+    return ids
